title: OpenVPN 2.4.0 through 2.6.23 and 2.7_alpha1 through 2.7.8 on Windows allows local authenticated users to execute…
description: A vulnerability in OpenVPN versions 2.4.0 through 2.6.23 and 2.7_alpha1 through 2.7.8 on Windows allows local authenticated users to execute arbitrary code via a privileged service by manipulating user-controlled environment variables.
